sources.label: Avant reserve fund and avUSD backing

reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened primary sources on 2026-07-28. Core-tokens still states avUSD is minted and redeemed 1:1 versus USDC. Reserve-fund docs still state that capital backing unstaked avAssets (including avUSD) is deployed into underlying strategies, and that the separate USD Reserve Fund is a loss backstop held in base-token form rather than the full backing stock. Yield-generation docs still describe market-neutral basis trades and multi-strategy deployment with a public transparency dashboard. Independently, the issuer avUSD metrics API (re-fetched 2026-07-28) returns a liability-aware transparency snapshot with periodEnd 2026-07-21T23:59:59+00:00: netNav 115903039.8680991 USD; leverage assetsUsd 961033819.0467469 and liabilitiesUsd 1208224702.799266; breakdown rows Stablecoins 115875654.649396, Other 10940396.9552925, ETH & Derivatives 3872.714028516711, AVAX & Derivatives 2096.497147409503, BTC & Derivatives 3.34879932509148, and Perpetuals -10918995.371568. The separately reported USD reserve-fund balance API returns about 1.07e6 USD at 0xd98e1faf532b9c481c56741ab3ac47ec18d8f43a and is not modeled as whole backing. A static positive-weight split would erase the portfolio's liabilities and hedge structure, so the structural 100% leveraged market-neutral basket with known-unknown disposition is retained.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer avUSD transparency balance sheet at 2026-07-21 and strategy documentation, re-opened 2026-07-28
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current constituent identities, positive and negative weights, venue exposures, hedge effectiveness, and net liability attribution remain intentionally unresolved in the static record and require a liability-aware live adapter.
